boundaries: No production writes, deployment, or model promotion
No overwrite of prior frozen cohorts or tournament artifacts
No sector label outside its exact observation date
No mixing of official and secondary sector evidence tiers
No fractional shares in executable modes
No invented actions, prices, dividends, liquidity, proceeds, or fee precision
No parameter tuning on exposed outcomes

evidence_boundary.selection_basis: Six annual historical decision dates; outcomes never enter their own training fit. Expanded retrospective research, not untouched confirmation.
evidence_boundary.supplementary_test: Previously exposed outcomes; descriptive rerun only and never fresh confirmation

execution_contract.automatic_action_policy: Exact official split, bonus and recovered consolidation ratios; test integer holdings at each consolidation date; fractional settlement value unavailable remains a blocker
execution_contract.blocking_action_policy: All rights deliberately lapse with no subscription or sale; supported resulting equities held at observed terminal prices; unknown fractions blocked.
execution_contract.corporate_action_authority: Official NSE symbol and BSE security-code observations mapped across ISIN changes
execution_contract.cost_policy: Gross core only because a complete reproducible historical broker contract is unavailable
execution_contract.dividend_policy: Price-only capital gains and residual cash for terminal wealth and parent risk features; dividends excluded consistently. Existing global baseline retains its original adjusted feature basis.
execution_contract.enhanced_carry_mode: Add contributions to cash; buy maximum integer shares; carry residual cash; include cash in terminal wealth and XIRR
execution_contract.enhanced_no_carry_mode: Floor each contribution separately; retain but do not reuse residual cash; include cash in terminal wealth and XIRR
execution_contract.liquidity_policy: No slippage or participation cap because complete historical order-book data is unavailable
execution_contract.price_source: Provider split-adjusted close reconstructed through source-history date; verified official nominal caches unchanged. Exact observed terminal repairs; no invented prices.
execution_contract.professor_mode: Floor each contribution divided by execution price; do not carry or include residual cash; rank by terminal gain divided by actual spend
execution_contract.schedule: Fixed calendar contribution; execute at next observed close within seven calendar days

primary_comparison: Same-row common cohort within each decision-date and investor-profile block

sector_diagnostic.evidence_boundary: Retrospective supplementary diagnostic with current-universe survivorship; no tuning or promotion
sector_diagnostic.method: Within-observed-industry percentile ranks on each exact snapshot date

training_label_policy: For every evaluation date, exclude training endpoints on or after that date.
